title: Norn project data
description: A project's own site data, beside package.json: what buildSite reads and a mapping passes to the layouts.

tagline.description: Defaults to the first sentence of the package.json description.

lede.description: Hero paragraph; defaults to the package.json description.

install.description: Install command; defaults to `npm install <package name>`.

usage.description: One copy-pasteable code sample under Usage.

features.description: Feature cards: three to six, each leading with what the project does for the reader.

logo.description: The project's wordmark: a file in content/assets/img/. Without it the header shows the name.

favicon.description: A file in content/assets/img/ (svg, png, ico, or webp). Without it the page links an empty icon, so browsers skip the /favicon.ico request.

appleTouchIcon.description: A 180px png in content/assets/img/ for home screens. Optional.

url.description: The site's URL. Without it, buildSite builds one from its `host` option and the repository name, or leaves it empty.

accent.description: A style setting: set `--norn-ui-accent` in the project's tokens.css.

fonts.description: A style setting: set `--norn-font-body` and `--norn-font-heading` in the project's tokens.css.
